note: Individual author fact/option/grammar/family-suitability pass, not independent review or a primary-only research claim. Reference excerpts and leads were actually inspected; candidate-match excerpts that selected incidental or later-adaptation material were supplemented with relevant opening/plot passages and targeted checks. Initial double-encoded apostrophe URLs for Alice and baker's yeast failed and were corrected before use. Slinky_Dog returned the broader Slinky toy article: actual dog-toy spring-body and Toy Story redesign passages were inspected, not merely the generic toy lead. Novel/film distinctions (Oz shoes, Kaa, dragon species), standard/variant game rules, uncommon biological exceptions and plant/food scope were explicitly considered. Existing exact bank stems were replaced with different practical facts, and the sole Family overlap candidate (Alice author versus NOT-a-character question) tests different information. Other categories can share basic subject knowledge with this mixed family category; global semantic uniqueness of every fact is not claimed. None of the new questions/options is about Harry Potter or Narnia. All 359 original Family questions are preserved and additions carry a dedicated auditVersion plus exact removal ID list.
